_about: Animation Attack clips: videos/anim/<class slug>-<1|2>.webm/.mp4/.jpg (added with tools/add_clip.py). clips = which clip numbers exist; since = first day the class can be the answer. credit / creditImage = who recorded the clips; shown on the win screen. days = fixed answers for puzzles #1, #2, ... by class name; after them a shuffled cycle over every class with a clip.
